Ok, maybe it's time for Thom to write his ballad, but he is the Warder, he must be ready to do what Moiraine needs him to do. I did not say Sharans were trouble, I just think it's something worth exploring, and, after all, not all of Shara sided with Demandred. They came during the Last Battle, what keeps them from coming again? What if the Seanchan get there first? What if they collar every Sharan channelers and attack the White and Black Towers?
